## What’s new

- **Stopping an agent now stops its sidecars.** Unmounting or deleting `moic` left `moic-slave` running against work whose driver was gone.
- **You are offered a handoff before an agent is stopped.** It is the last moment the agent can be asked what it was doing. Only offered while it is running.
- **Every agent is asked to leave a handoff, not just ones that received one.** Before, the first run of an agent left nothing, so the next found nothing.
- **One context menu for every agent square.** Start, Restart, Edit, Unmount and Delete, always. “Duplicate” and the project move/detach items are gone.
- **An answer to your question no longer reads as a note from yourself.** Answers say they came from you; ordinary mail still reads as mail.

## Migration

- No action is required.
